auth.systemHint: Uses OS credential helpers and SSH keys

proxy.label: Proxy mode
proxy.hintSystem: Follow the operating system's proxy settings.

proxy.hintManual: Use a fixed HTTP(S) proxy server.
proxy.invalid: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL with a host and port and no path, query, or credentials.

diagnostics.title: Prerequisites
diagnostics.gitMissing: Git is required but not found. Install Git and try again.
diagnostics.gitXetMissing: Git-Xet extension is recommended for LFS files.
diagnostics.credentialHelperMissing: Git Credential Manager is recommended for HTTPS authentication.
diagnostics.sshMissing: SSH agent is required for SSH transport.

derivedUrl.label: Remote URL
derivedUrl.hint: This credential-free URL will be cloned

queue.title: Clone queue
queue.emptyBody: Clone a model, dataset, or space to work with it locally. Tasks run one at a time.

filter.label: Filter by status
filter.emptyBody: Choose another filter, or start a new clone.

statusHint.queued: Waiting for the active clone to finish
statusHint.failed: The clone failed. Retry into a new empty folder.
statusHint.cancelled: This clone was cancelled. Retry into a new empty folder.
statusHint.interrupted: Interrupted by a shutdown or crash. The destination folder may be partial. Retry into a new empty folder.

banner.interrupted: Interrupted — the app shut down or the worker stopped while cloning. The destination folder may be partial. Nothing was deleted.

detail.retryInfoBody: In-place resume is not supported. A retry clones the repository again into a NEW EMPTY folder; nothing already on disk is overwritten or deleted.

action.cancelConfirmBody: The clone is stopped. The destination folder may be left partial and is never deleted.
action.retryBody: A retry clones into a NEW EMPTY folder. Resume in place is not supported and existing files are never overwritten or deleted.

retryError.required: Enter a new empty destination folder
retryError.same: Choose a different folder — the previous attempt's folder may contain partial files.

errors.gitNotFound: Git is not installed or not in PATH
errors.gitXetNotFound: Git-Xet extension is required but not found
errors.sshNotAvailable: SSH is required for SSH transport but not available
errors.tokenRequired: App token authentication requires signing in first
errors.destinationError: Cannot access or validate destination folder
errors.openFailed: Could not open the destination folder
errors.loadFailed: Could not load the clone queue
